cues.text: A room in the love hotel, with a large round bed in the middle. You sit alone on its edge, bent forward, holding your head.
You get up from the bed. Yukari comes out of the bathroom wrapped in a towel and walks slowly toward you, her eyes lowered.
Yukari has a hand pressed to your chest. She snaps out of it, clutches the towel to herself and dashes off toward the bathroom.
The bathroom door opens and Yukari comes out again, dressed in her school uniform, and stops in front of you.
